card.name: Behavior and mental-health condition text
card.fires_on: Words in passages on child behavior, parenting therapy and psychiatric conditions such as bipolar disorder or ADHD. It marks words like "behavior" in behavior therapy or problem children, and linking words in descriptions of mood or conduct problems.

modes.label: The word behavior
modes.description: The word "behavior" inside parent-child therapy and behavior management phrases.
modes.example: parents learn to use specific<< behavior>> management techniques as they play with their child

modes.label: Linking words in condition descriptions
modes.description: Small words such as "not", "from" or "are" in sentences describing bipolar disorder or how sufferers are perceived.
modes.example: Bipolar disorder is<< not>> easy to spot when it starts.

card.writes: It leans toward words about disappointment or motivation and away from words starting with "comp" such as compulsive, which is a weak and mixed signal.
card.plain: It lights up in text about children's behavior problems and mood disorders, especially on the word "behavior".
